title: SLOW English Podcast for Beginners! -- talking about 👉friends

header.titleZh: 適合初學者的慢速英語播客！ ——談論👉朋友
header.titleEn: SLOW English Podcast for Beginners! -- talking about 👉friends

sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: This podcast is for A1 beginner listeners.
sentences.tc: 此播客適合 A1 初學者聽眾。

sentences.en: Today I will be talking about friends I have a few friends.
sentences.tc: 今天我要談朋友，我有幾個朋友。

sentences.en: I feel stressed from work or home or life.
sentences.tc: 我因工作、家庭或生活而感到壓力。

tags.meaning: 人物與關係相關的常用字
tags.note: 看到 friends 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: I can always talk to my friends if.
sentences.tc: 如果我可以隨時和我的朋友聊天。

sentences.en: I ever need to vent I can always talk to my friends my friends make me smile.
sentences.tc: 當我需要發洩時，我總是可以和我的朋友交談，我的朋友讓我微笑。

sentences.en: When I'm feeling down my friends make me laugh?
sentences.tc: 當我心情低落時，我的朋友會逗我笑嗎？

sentences.en: I laugh a lot with my friends.
sentences.tc: 我和朋友們常常開懷大笑。

sentences.en: We laugh about everything and anything who makes you smile who makes you laugh when you're feeling down.
sentences.tc: 我們會嘲笑所有讓你微笑的事情，以及在你情緒低落時讓你發笑的任何事情。

sentences.en: Sometimes I will go eat with my friends.
sentences.tc: 有時我會和朋友一起去吃飯。

sentences.en: We like to eat tacos I always get the longanisa tacos those tacos are.
sentences.tc: 我們喜歡吃炸玉米餅，我總是買龍阿尼薩炸玉米餅，這些炸玉米餅就是。

sentences.en: What are your favorite kind of tacos?
sentences.tc: 你最喜歡哪一種玉米餅？

sentences.en: I like to hang out with my friends.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡和朋友們一起出去玩。

sentences.en: We hang out as at the mall the market the fair even at restaurants or parties.
sentences.tc: 我們像在商場、市場、市集、甚至在餐廳或聚會上一樣閒逛。

sentences.en: I would do without my friends full podcast on YouTube and Spotify try not to read the subtitles.
sentences.tc: 如果我的朋友不在 YouTube 和 Spotify 上觀看完整的播客，我會盡量不要閱讀字幕。
